corrected_proposal.full_proposal_markdown:
# Proposal: Warehouse Visibility Platform for NordFrame Logistics
**Submitted by:** Apex Logistics Solutions

## Executive Summary
Apex Logistics Solutions is pleased to present this comprehensive proposal for NordFrame Logistics GmbH. Our proposed solution delivers a high-performance web-based inventory dashboard consolidating tracking across all 6 regional warehouses in Germany and Austria.

## Technical Solution
- **Real-Time Dashboard:** Web-based responsive interface displaying live inventory levels across all 6 sites.
- **Database Integration:** Native, secure integration with your existing PostgreSQL database using connection pooling.
- **Role-Based Access Control:** Strict site-level isolation ensuring managers access only authorized regional data.
- **Automated Alerts:** Proactive low-stock notification engine configured for instant manager dispatch.

## Timeline & Onboarding
- **Phase 1 (Months 1–3):** Requirements finalization, pilot deployment at the Munich warehouse.
- **Phase 2 (Months 4–6):** Full rollout and user onboarding across the remaining 5 regional warehouses.

## Assumptions, Limitations & Risks (REQ-07 Compliance)
- **Assumptions:** NordFrame will provide necessary PostgreSQL read-write access credentials and VPN connectivity prior to kickoff.
- **Limitations:** Real-time sync frequency is capped at 5-second intervals to preserve database performance.
- **Risks & Mitigation:** Potential data format variances across legacy spreadsheets will be reconciled using our automated data cleansing pipeline during migration.

## Pricing & SLAs
- **Fixed Price:** €98,500 total.
- **Support & Maintenance:** Includes Year 1 24/7 SLA with a 1-hour response time for critical issues.
